## Executable evidence

`src/domain/b0-5-contracts.test.ts` proves:

- disclosure semantics are versioned;
- stale disclosure receipts are invalid;
- raw BYOK cannot enter durable AI preference schema;
- BYOK store is non-enumerable and clearable;
- BYOK transport is limited to HTTPS or explicit loopback HTTP;
- capability routing follows the signed model matrix;
- no-cloud mode produces no Gemini attempt;
- cloud-enabled mode plans Gemini before Ollama.

`src/security/b0-5-secret-boundary.test.ts` proves source-level secret boundaries:

- platform Gemini secret is not a `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` variable;
- browser persistence APIs are absent from BYOK handling;
- current Supabase SSR auth primitives are used.

The UI consumes the BYOK secure-origin policy and disables the credential path on insecure remote HTTP.

## Deferred dynamic evidence

The following acceptance criteria require a real provider invocation path that intentionally belongs to B6/B8 rather than the B0.5 foundation:

SERVER_PROVIDER_LOG_SECRET_CANARY
